verdict.rationale: Paxos documents an API path for fiat-to-stablecoin conversion. End-user identities can be onboarded, fiat deposit instructions can be created for Wire or CUBIX, and a mint orchestration automatically converts incoming bank transfers to stablecoins and transfers them in one call, with webhooks for status. However, there is no embeddable widget and no card payment rail, so this is a backend bank-wire onramp the developer must build a UI around. Missing for 10: card purchase support, an embeddable onramp widget/UI, ACH or other consumer bank-transfer rails beyond wire/CUBIX, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-user buy flow.
